title: MRCS-13 ↔ MIB-14 Definition Bridge

selection_basis.strict_order: OARC-01 → OARC-02 → OARC-03 → OARC-04 → OARC-05 → OARC-06 → OARC-07
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MSAS remains terminal completed_verified; MRCS-16 remains independently selected_not_started.

objective: Prove that MRCS-13 authored reusable item/equipment/vehicle/construct/modular-component definitions, slots, owner references and versioned compatibility can bridge into existing MIB-14 operational definitions/configurations without duplicate records, invented compatibility or a parallel modular grammar.
acceptance: The actual MRCS-13 package/owner-reference model is mapped to the actual MIB-14 operational definition/module/facility model.
Definition identity and provenance remain stable across the bridge rather than being copied into OARC-specific canonical records.
Explicit slot/component/compatibility semantics cross the bridge without inferred compatibility or silent defaults.
Unknown or source-unspecified bridge fields remain visibly unresolved.
Any genuine representational gap is recorded as the narrowest existing-owner-compatible integration requirement rather than a new OARC runtime/schema family.
OARC01.AUTHORITY_HANDOFF.v1 field-admission and future MERA/MBES reservation rules remain satisfied.
boundaries: MRCS-13 remains completed reusable-definition authoring authority and is not silently reopened.
MIB-14 remains operational configuration foundation authority; D17 remains live Asset truth.
OARC-02 may add a bounded adapter/bridge/validator but no second modular-definition grammar, Asset ledger or operational runtime.
MERA engineering topology/runtime and MBES built-environment topology/runtime remain reserved and unauthorized.
Source-unspecified capacities, component parentage, compatibility, system facts and operating envelopes remain unresolved rather than inferred.
MSAS and MRCS lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an OARC-specific owner Continue, fresh-read OARC-02, OARC01.AUTHORITY_HANDOFF.v1, MRCS-13 application contracts and the live MIB-14 implementation model, then execute the complete bounded definition-bridge tranche.
